subject: Mathematics
overall_comment: Pair 2 clears the strict bar. F1.1 is the named target and the lesson/worksheet both practise exact change via subtraction; expanded_walkthrough explicitly bridges from Day 1 estimate ('Yesterday Pat estimated. Today Bea calculates exact') to Lessons 3/4/5. The Grade 3 trap is research-grounded: borrow-without-decrement cited to Fuson on multidigit subtraction and Carpenter & Moser CGI separate-result-unknown, with three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: borrows but doesn't decrement; B: loses the decimal; C: gets answer but cannot articulate). Materials are everyday (anchor chart, money/price cards, calculator cards) with Pat+Bea explicitly OPTIONAL and a NO-PAPER cube-borrow alternative in differentiation. Bea's quotable refrain 'LINE UP, BORROW, SUBTRACT — that's EXACT!' opens the hook and closes the exit_routine (3x chant). Mathematical authenticity hits Level 4 via the STRATEGY COMPARE 'Show me YOUR way' beat in action step 6 (count up from 13, take 7 from 20, regroup) with Carpenter & Moser CGI cited. Worksheet Part 3 ($48, pay $50) is a deliberate transfer task — different combination, regroup-near-zero — not a rote repeat of the four Part 1 problems.
